notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Hi, fixed some major problems and added quality of life features:

-Fixed bug where on high or low res monitor you will shoot in wrong direction.

-Fixed bug where dash immunity frames and immunity frames after taking damage will cancel each other.

-Increased immunity frames after taking damage from 1.5s to 2s.

-Added pause menu with options and ability to restart level or quit the game.

-Volume of the game will now start at 20% when first running the game.



https://store.steampowered.com/app/3271270/BLOODBULLETS_Demo/
